Modelled in Blender and textured in Substance Painter. Free to download but its really nothing fancy :)

results.name: Backrooms-level-TheHub-Canone
results.description:
[WIKI](https://backrooms.fandom.com/wiki/The_Hub)

The Hub is a mysterious level behind the Scenes. It is a safe place for any traveler who decides to pass by it and/or live in it. The hub, apparently, is a tunnel, on each side of which there are both locked and open doors.

The hub is an endless dimly lit underground road tunnel. The tunnel floor is a dry paved road with three sections consisting of yellow lines. The walls are covered with large concrete slabs with seams that are visible in the places where the new slab begins. There are also light yellow lamps along the walls, thanks to which the Hub's lighting has an orange hue. Usually the Hub has turns to the left, right, up and down, which is the reason for the unreliability of the tunnel layout in some places, however, due to its direct paths, movement along the level is not difficult.

results.name: Plesetsk Cosmodrome site 41 pad 1
results.description: This is site 41, pad 1 at the Plesetsk Cosmodrome. Its the only "abandoned" Soyuz launch pad. It was active from 1959-1989 before it was dismanteled, and "canibalized" for another Soyuz launchpad. The only remains of it (as shown in the model) is its bare, concrete pad, flame deflector, and is single "Service Tunnel". The Service Cabin, "Tulip" truss arms, Service gantry halves, and fueling masts have been removed.
